# Northwind Coffee Roasters

> Small-batch specialty coffee roaster based in Leeds, United Kingdom,
> shipping across the UK since 2014.

## Key pages

- [Pricing](http://localhost:8901/pricing.html): Subscriptions from GBP 29 per month, delivery included.
- [About](http://localhost:8901/about.html): Founded 2014, 12 staff, Leeds.
- [Contact](http://localhost:8901/contact.html): Address, hours, phone.
